segments.sensitive: One reviewer explicitly states she does not have sensitive skin and experiences no irritation even with a high active percentage.

concerns.spots: Reviewers report that dark spots and dark sun spots faded with continued use, including one who used it specifically for post-acne marks and another for pigmentation; no dissent reported.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer bought the serum during a period of bad breakouts and reports her skin doing well since incorporating it into a routine with other medicube products, though the improvement she highlights is mainly on the marks left behind rather than active breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer credits the serum with making pores appear smaller, an effect she considers her favorite benefit.

I really like this product. It took some time but it significantly cleared up dark spots left behind from my acne. I bought it when I was having bad breakouts and still use it to this day. I'd been hearing really good things about it and decided to give it a try. I use the medicube red foam cleanser, followed by the medicube exosome shot 2000, and then finish with this serum. My skin has been doing really well since I started this regimen.

This is a very effective K beauty niacinamide product for a great price. I've used another niacinamide only product that had increased in price so I did a lot of research and found this through dermatologist Dr. Dray's recommendation. It has a watery consistency that is easy to pat on by itself but I like to apply this nightly by mixing a few drops in with another lightweight serum and spreading over my face and neck. It definitely helps with dark sun spots but my favorite benefit is how much smaller it makes my pores appear. It is bright pink because of the addition of B12, which calms the skin. The addition of tranexamic acid is a nice bonus too. I do not have sensitive skin so I like as high a percentage of active ingredient as possible and I have no irritation whatsoever with this. It's a winner!
Use it every morning for couple of months and you'll see your pigmentation disappear
